# Paul Suarez, MS, PMHNP-BC

> Board-certified psychiatric nurse practitioner (PMHNP-BC) specializing in adult ADHD. Telehealth practice for adults located in New York State, also licensed in Florida. Evaluates and diagnoses ADHD, accepts patients with a prior diagnosis or psychological testing report, and provides ADHD medication management including stimulants and other controlled medications when clinically appropriate. Also treats anxiety and depression. Practicing since 2016; MSN, New York University. NPI 1225581424.

Key facts:
- Adults 18+ only; all visits by secure video; patient must be in New York or Florida during visits
- Initial evaluation 60 minutes, $300; follow-ups 30 minutes, $300, usually monthly
- Out-of-network with insurance; superbills provided in the patient portal after every visit; payment by Zelle or Venmo (HSA cards usually work through Venmo); no credit cards
- Book online at https://intakeq.com/booking/2kvabe
- Phone 646-820-8575; email info@paulsuarez.com
